mission: Prevent any future discovery of organic material inside an Osirian container, mummy-equipment object or reliquary from being promoted to a literal Osiris-member claim until the biological class and provenance are independently resolved.
reason_for_gate: Public museum and archaeological records demonstrate that objects explicitly described as Osiris mummies or Osirian reliquaries can contain cereal/vegetal matter, animal remains, feathers/bone fragments, linen, resin and other ritual substitutes. Therefore ORGANIC_CORE is a discovery class, not an identity.

controls.institution: Musee du Louvre, Departement des Antiquites egyptiennes
controls.discovery: March-April 1903 excavation by Gustave Lefebvre and Pierre Jouguet
controls.associated_container: E 12182 A, miniature falcon-headed coffin; excavated as one ensemble with four Sons of Horus figures
controls.classification_control: The Louvre bibliography includes Centrone, Egyptian Corn-mummies, and modern scholarship identifies the Tehneh 1903 sacred-area finds as corn-mummies rather than human Osiris remains.

controls.finding: Modern study reports that the 1903 Tehneh excavation found roughly 70-80 shallow pits in a dedicated sacred area; 28 undamaged sarcophagi preserved falcon-headed wooden coffins containing corn-mummies.
controls.effect: A whole excavated Osirian mummy cemetery can represent ritually manufactured vegetal Osiris bodies.

impact_on_CG53469.previous_priority: X-ray / CT / micro-CT remains the primary internal-content gate
impact_on_CG53469.new_rule: If imaging detects an internal core, the verdict may only advance to CORE_PRESENT until its material/taxonomic class is established.
human_tissue_pass_requirements: non-destructive morphology or imaging consistent with human tissue/bone where possible
biomolecular or histological analysis only if lawful, ethically approved and conservation-compatible
exclude embalming packing, resin, textile, cereal, animal mummy and later conservation material
impact_on_CG53469.identity_ceiling: Even HUMAN_TISSUE does not establish OSIRIS_IDENTITY. It would first be tested against the much stronger default explanation of tissue or funerary material belonging to the human burial occupant Nesbanebdjedet.

canonical_formula: ORGANIC_CORE -> CLASSIFY -> HUMAN_TEST -> PROVENANCE_TEST -> IDENTITY_TEST; NEVER ORGANIC_CORE -> OSIRIS
canonical_seal: THE ANCIENTS MADE BODIES FOR OSIRIS. FIRST PROVE WHAT THE BODY IS MADE OF; ONLY THEN ASK WHOSE BODY IT WAS.
